build_flags.tree_at_build: Identical Rust source to accepted 4ad0c998; clean cd2cecb9 before evidence and pipeline edits.

profile: max-perf, default features, debug=line-tables-only on both sides
status: accepted build-only PGO gain; PHPStan parity remains open

unfiltered_build.status: not measured; compile-time profiles outside the fixed training selection

profile_warnings_review.meaning: Expected missing compile-time profiles; those inputs were intentionally excluded from runtime training.

micro_counts.protocol: One native instructions:u count at zero and five million iterations; same source except loop bound; CPU 2 and identical environment; not a timing distribution

protocol.application: Two separate CPU-2 windows, each PHP/baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline/PHP, fresh result cache each run, OS caches warm. No window pooling. Actual analysis timers; hardware counts cover the entire command. Five files and twenty findings, matching exit/stdout/stderr.
protocol.controls: First short controls, five seeded long pairs, five deep pairs per size and five pairs of each additional application holdout. Two separate application windows with two samples per runtime per window; no pooling or discarded valid samples.
protocol.training: Exactly the fixed 18 programs, excluding PHPStan and all target holdouts. Instrumented, baseline and final checksums agree with PHP. Runtime profiles selected by per-program provenance; 21 automatic build-script profiles excluded.
protocol.limits: 6 GiB aggregate, zero swap, exclusive lock, all processes inherit boundary. Native x86-64 only; no new JIT lowering or ABI.

limitations: PGO is a build-only improvement; no Rust semantic, Value, frame or JIT change. No new whole-matrix run for unchanged Rust source; 53 direct differential programs and 18 training-output checks run on this exact final executable.

The initial build merged automatic build-script profiles and is preserved as an unmeasured superseded artifact. The measured rebuild uses exactly the 18 runtime profiles. All 26 function warnings are missing build_script_build data, with no runtime profile mismatch warnings.

The shell pipeline is updated to reproduce the measured flags and fixed training selection with separate build/runtime profile directories. Shell syntax and manifest hashes pass. The equivalent two-stage command sequence produced the measured artifact; the refactored shell entrypoint has not been rebuilt separately.
Code size is not uniformly smaller: main executor grows from 341653 to 395497 bytes while total text decreases. A smaller executor is not the acceptance criterion.
No ARM64 native timing or whole-application allocation counts. Small additional holdout timings include sub-millisecond cases; these do not support broad speedup claims.
PHPStan still executes about 7.93 times as many whole-command user instructions and spends about 9.60 times as long in analysis as reference PHP in the confirmation window.
